newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-TRANSVAAL BEAT N.TRANSVAAL 31-21 IN CURRIE CUP.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-TRANSVAAL BEAT N.TRANSVAAL 31-21 IN CURRIE CUP.

text.p: Transvaal 31-21 to reach the final of the Currie Cup on
Transvaal - Tries: Gavin Lawless, Japie Mulder, Rudolf
Straeuli. Conversions: Gavin Lawless (2). Penalties: Gavin
Lawless (3). Drop Goal: Hennie le Roux.
Northern Transvaal - Tries: Jacques Olivier, Penalty Try.
Conversion: Lance Sherrell. Penalties: Lance Sherrell (3).
